notes.title: WIP: Flying Things VR is getting colors!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As you may already know, Flying Things VR already has its physics base prepared. The flying and building systems are working how we'd like it to, and since our team has finished developing basic mechanics, we are ready to move on with the next steps.

What now? 

Here comes the adventure!

In order to provide you with the best virtual experience, our story & design team is focusing on bringing magic into the VR gameplay. Right now Giant Lazer designers are working on the details of:

 the main character and his journey,
 all the fellows he would eventually meet on his way,
 special quests and items that will help you discover the whole story,
 beautiful locations to visit while flying around our dreamy, low-poly world,
 buildings, patterns, and fantastic nature.


We are proud of the progress of this project and at the same time, we feel hyped about what's to come. 

For more details feel free to join us on Discord!

Yours truly,
Giant Lazer
